name: Sinsations
source:
Sinsations is an 18+ visual novel set in modern Las Vegas. You play as Lust, a newly recruited Deadly Sin. Lust has been given a task from Lucifer to prove his worth: seduce the other six Deadly Sins, within two months.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1660363304/sinsations-a-bl-yaoi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
